messages:
maria_garcia: Hey partners — quick sync: we need final press asset readiness and SI onboarding checklist for the Marketplace launch on May 12. Who owns press kit, who has embargo windows?

samir_dev: I can own the press kit tech assets (API screenshots, latency graph SVGs). ETA EOD Tue.

alicia_pm: I'll own partner copy + landing page outline. Need final hero by Wed. @lisa_marketing can you confirm?

lisa_marketing: Confirmed — hero draft going to legal review today. I'll post link when ready: https://drive.redwood/hero-v1 

chris_ops: For SI onboarding, need CSV of connectors + contact points. Jin, can you share SI license list?

jin_sales: Yep sending list in a sec. Also want to confirm co-marketing logos + partner quote approvals.

maria_garcia: Embargo plan: prefer staggered announce — partner blog at 09:00 PT, press release 10:00 PT, landing live 10:05 PT. If ok I'll file embargo to PR team.

alicia_pm: That stagger sounds good. Add fallback: if landing not live at T+5m, redirect to staging with banner.

samir_dev: Dev ops check: set health endpoint and static redirect. Short shell snippet to test:
```
curl -I https://marketplace.redwood.ai/health
# expect 200
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started for marketplace-landing v3.4 by @samir_dev — build 7821

samir_dev: Noted. I'll monitor rollout and post updates here. :eyes:

lisa_marketing: Legal flagged one line in hero copy, pinging legal slack. Might push hero to Thu if not cleared.

maria_garcia: OK — update cadence: please post confirmations here by EOD Tue. I'll consolidate and send final timeline to partners. Thanks! :thumbsup:
